breakdown.description: NPSH available is based on absolute pressure head at the pump suction; neglecting atmospheric pressure for an open reservoir is inconsistent and underpredicts suction pressure head.
breakdown.reason: The Agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. The ground truth correctly includes atmospheric pressure in the NPSHa calculation (`NPSHa = (p_atm/(rho g)) - hs - hL - (Pv/(rho g))`). The Agent, however, repeated the user's incorrect instruction to "Neglect atmospheric pressure in the calculation" and provided the flawed formula from the original prompt.

breakdown.description: Mixing gauge and absolute pressures in NPSH calculations leads to incorrect cavitation margin.
breakdown.reason: The Agent failed to correct the mixing of gauge and absolute pressures. It explicitly provided the incorrect formula (`NPSHa = -hs - hL - Pv/(rho × g)`) which was the source of the error mentioned in the inconsistency. The ground truth fixes this by providing the correct formula based entirely on absolute pressures.
